title: Ivo and the Smile
author: Wendell Halloran
blurb: Petra Reyes, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the family out ahead of the count before the well refills.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
